verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents its own import and export of realms as JSON files, plus operator-automated realm import. A community user confirms loading a realm from JSON, and the Admin CLI/REST API and SCIM endpoints support scripted user management. None of the evidence states that exports include users or that password hashes are preserved on import or export. missing for 10: explicit documentation that realm import/export covers users in bulk, password-hash import/export (algorithms, credential format), hands-on corroboration of a hash-preserving migration in and out.
